---
title: Landscape and desktop layout
labels: ui
---

## Problem
- Phone landscape (844×390): the header, minutes picker and "Showing" button fill the screen, so no exercise is visible above the tab bar.
- Desktop: a single 560px column with lots of empty space.

## Ideas
- Landscape: collapse the minutes row into the header, shrink the picture, or put the picture beside the sets.
- Desktop ≥ 900px: two columns: plan list on the left, the open exercise card on the right (or History beside Today).

## Done when
- [ ] Up-next card name + Save visible in phone landscape
- [ ] Desktop uses the width without stretching text lines
